# Native conversion input loan

Four real Witness reds show cloned or foreign numeric and named conversions acquire count authority through borrowed valid b.N reads. ConversionOperand authenticates one selected Convert or ChangeType and its direct source input before lending it. Go owns conversion semantics. Witness retains benchmark policy; Phi, storage and arbitrary-depth execution remain explicit later work.

Prove native/foreign/untaken triad, invalid requests and input custody, native cancellation cause, source parameter identity across22 representation families with optional prefix and untaken blocks, and32/8193 prefix allocation. Each semantic source fault must fail a load-bearing assertion; compile failures and resource waits remain separate development facts. Race and tools precede serial3s benchmark then3s semantic fuzz. Release only after evidence and concurrent version/index recheck. Independent acceptance and final Witness lint remain outstanding.

## Function value input

Witness's real iterator benchmark exposes a missing native input family: a
named function representation conversion can borrow a function declaration,
which is not a storage instruction. Authenticate that function through Go's
existing object/origin and lexical-parent bindings, then use go/types to
prove its signature is convertible. Keep storage inputs on the existing
path. Do not add a function registry or a Witness-specific exclusion.

The function-value table covers package declarations, noncapturing literals,
captured literals, generic instances and imported declarations. Damaged loans
cover copied identities, another compiler program, a foreign lexical parent,
an incompatible or missing signature, missing/typed-nil inputs and cancellation causes.
The four authored function patches each remove one independent identity,
signature presence, convertibility or lexical check; its corresponding hostile leaf must fail on the
mutant and reject on the restored candidate. Numeric conversion, untaken-block,
refusal, finite-domain and allocation evidence remain separate scoped checks.

Keep the Witness declaration-level failure and retry alongside these local
producer observations. Passing producer tests alone does not prove the
consumer's benchmark classification or close Witness's remaining findings.

The function benchmark queries the real noncapturing-literal conversion from
the consumer failure. Its loop checks the borrowed operand identity and native
refusal; compiler setup occurs before the timed query loop. Keep its3s result
separate from the existing numeric conversion benchmark.


## First-principles claims

| Claim | Evidence and status | Consequence / smallest remaining check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Every native conversion input is a storage value. | DISPROVED: the actual Witness iterator declaration and four real compiler function families refuse the original query. | Authenticate function operands through the existing Go object/origin/lexical binding, then ask go/types about convertibility. |
| Existing native bindings distinguish an original from a copied or foreign function. | VERIFIED: real-source hostile cases and identity/lexical guard mutations fail; restored failed leaves pass with their original seeds. | Keep one native authority; add no product registry. |
| Signature compatibility and signature presence are independent obligations. | VERIFIED: removing compatibility admits Wrong(int); removing presence panics in native type processing. Restored failed leaves pass. | Retain both guards; no custom type rules. |
| The new query retains no instruction or function population. | VERIFIED by source: it borrows one operand and follows existing native ancestry without a collection. Numeric allocation/domain regressions pass. | Function allocation measurements remain a separate benchmark obligation, not a whole-program memory claim. |
| Passing this producer closes Witness's consumer or the migration. | UNVERIFIED: real consumer retry and remaining self-lint are separate work. | Publish Primitive before adoption, then retry the original consumer failure. |
| Anvil universally speeds this work. | UNVERIFIED: native execution, build/preparation and admission vary independently; retained timings include material waits. | Report exact measured phases in Anvil's complaint log; do not invent a speed ratio. |

Fundamental constraints are native identity, native convertibility, selected
instruction custody and caller-owned cancellation. The implementation adds only
the missing function operand branch; all other inputs retain their existing
query. O(1) here concerns retained stream population, never elapsed runtime.
